title: Record each surface, then compose
reader: A technical evaluator or agent builder who needs work to cross two applications (for example intake in an EMR, then posting in billing) without the second app acting on a guessed identifier.
proposed_title: Two apps, one checked fact: how OpenAdapt hands work between systems
thesis: When work crosses two applications, the second one should start only from a fact the first one saved and checked, not from what was on the screen.

facts_that_must_survive.fact: openadapt-flow compose (Flow #430, merged 2026-08-29) puts two recorded programs under a parent; the second starts only after the first ends done and checked, and only with a parameter the first one's record check confirmed. Missing evidence stops the parent. replay refuses a composed parent; certify and run execute it. If every child finishes but the parent can't confirm the whole, the outcome is 'finished, not checked' (COMPLETED_UNVERIFIED).

Process contracts shipped after the August posts: openadapt.process-contract/v0 (Flow #434, 2026-08-29) and v1 (Flow #444, 2026-08-31). V1 runs Flow, Code, and Human children in one process, passes files by digest, and refuses a terminal success until the declared verifier confirms them. V0 remains supported.

A composition map exists on Flow main (docs/showcase-compose/program-graph.html and .png). Check what visualize draws today before repeating 'A composition map is the next surface. It isn't shipping today.'

WindowsWorld (arXiv 2604.27776): 181 tasks across 17 Windows applications, 78% need more than one app; best final success 20.44% (Gemini-3-flash-preview, screenshot plus accessibility tree). Step-matched subset: 10.92 vs 11.26 expert steps; intermediate score 65.74% to 35.14%; final success 46.15% to 14.29%.
OSWorld (2024), corrected wording: GPT-4V averaged 13.74% on single-app tasks and at best 6.57% on tasks across apps.
UFO2 posted 9.1% on OSWorld-W cross-app tasks in all four configurations; a small subset, don't generalize.
OpenAdapt has not been run on WindowsWorld; the external numbers describe agents, not a composed Flow parent.
Healthy children make no model calls; the parent doesn't add one.

title: When should I use OpenAdapt instead of an API?
reader: A technical buyer or developer choosing between an API, a script (Playwright, Selenium, AutoHotkey), and a recorded workflow for one task.
proposed_title: API, script, or recorded workflow: how to choose
thesis: Use a supported API first, keep a script its owner can watch, and record a workflow only for the screen-only step that other people depend on and that needs its save checked.

facts_that_must_survive.fact: Rule: call the supported API first; if it exposes the whole operation, the decision is over. Automate only the step with no supported machine interface.
A read-only API can check a write the screen made. After a timeout following a save, a person checks the record before anything is retried (never a blind retry).
AutoHotkey: Send simulates input to the active window; ControlClick and ControlSend address a control directly. Keep a personal macro while its author watches it.
Playwright: OpenAdapt's browser recorder is Playwright-native and keeps DOM identity; actionability checks and the trace viewer are reasons to keep Playwright in the browser path.
Selenium WebDriver is a W3C Recommendation; Selenium Grid routes commands to remote browsers. A timeout after a consequential click can mean nothing happened or the save went through.
HTTP status codes describe request handling, not the business result.

title: The Most Dangerous Branch in a Safety Taxonomy Is the One Reached by Doing Nothing
reader: A safety or backend engineer who writes classifiers or enums with a fallthrough branch.
proposed_title: An empty evidence list isn't proof of no effect
thesis: A loop that finds nothing wrong in an empty list returns the same answer as one that checked everything, so a safety outcome reached by elimination needs a branch that proves something was checked.

facts_that_must_survive.fact: _has_unresolved_uncertainty() walked result.effect_evidence and returned False both when no entry was uncertain and when the list was empty because verification never ran. classify_transaction_outcome() then fell through to HALTED_BEFORE_EFFECT ('stopped before saving') for a halted run with no policy rejection, even when an action may have landed.
